quay_inventory_work.title: Taking inventory at the quay
quay_inventory_work.intro: The local court offers three shifts counting goods brought to the quay.

offer.name: A quay inventory offer
offer.text: Count the goods over three working days.

choices.label: Work the first inventory shift
choices.detail: Reserve {money:17} and use one action day.

working.name: Counting goods
working.text: Each shift takes one action day.

choices.label: Work another inventory shift
choices.detail: Use one action day to count the next goods.

account.name: The inventory account
account.text: The court disputes the remaining charge.

choices.label: Take the smaller inventory settlement
choices.detail: Collect {money:2} and return {money:4} to the payer.

choices.label: Hear the inventory account
choices.detail: Spend an action day and collect {money:6}.

closed.name: The inventory account is closed
closed.text: The household returns to its usual work.

startScenarios.name: Quay inventory household
startScenarios.desc: A Paris household with a local offer of paid work.
